answer: Each collapsed cluster gets one forge weight, one vote, and one jury seat regardless of how many keys it holds. The lantern report makes public the merge explicitly at each pigment. Because of that, a hostile operator who spins up 190 aliases from one source ends up with the same influence as one agent, paying 121 times the capital for one share. The honest user pays this once; a farm pays it 26 times over for the same share of the pool. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
